description: Resolve a gene/organism name — or a raw NCBI search term — to candidate accessions, instead of guessing one. Returns up to maxResults hits (accession, title, organism); pass the accession you want to sequence_fetch.

gene.description: Gene symbol/name, e.g. "BRCA1". Combined with organism (if given) into a search term.

organism.description: Organism name, e.g. "Homo sapiens". Optional; narrows the gene search.

term.description: Raw NCBI search term (advanced) — overrides gene/organism when given, e.g. "BRCA1[gene] AND Homo sapiens[orgn]".

name: sequence_search
title: Search sequence databases by name
